key_insight: PACT shows that token-level credit in RL for LLM post-training can be uniquely defined by three regularity conditions, and that aligning the critic with this credit leads to better training.
engineering_relevance: The paper offers a principled way to design actor-critic updates for LLMs and agents, improving stability and performance in reasoning and code-solving tasks.
method: Defines token-level credit via Completeness, Prefix Consistency, and Neutrality
Connects OPD, RLOO, and GAE to the same credit framework
Introduces PACT with Actor-then-Critic updates and importance-sampling correction
evidence_signal: PACT reports 72.87% average accuracy across four math reasoning benchmarks and a 67.4% pass rate on SWE-bench Verified, outperforming PPO, GRPO, and SAO in the abstract.
watch_item: The actor-then-critic correction relies on accurate importance sampling and critic updates, so practical gains may depend on how well policy shift and critic error are controlled.
paper_title: PACT: From Credit Assignment to Critic Alignment
